Can you see yourself sailing through the canals of Amsterdam, giving guests an unforgettable experience? Do you get energy from people, fun and a bit of excitement around you? Then this is your chance! For this season (March to October) KINboat Amsterdam is looking for enthusiastic hosts on board. This is your responsibility: 
As a host on board you will sail through the canals of Amsterdam together with the skipper on our open boats. You ensure that our guests have an unforgettable experience. You welcome guests, tell fun stories about the city and serve drinks during the cruise. You are the face of KINboat on the water! This is what you do in a day: 
- Welcoming our guests enthusiastically on board - Telling stories about Amsterdam and the highlights along the route - Serving drinks and making sure everyone is provided - Creating a cozy and relaxed atmosphere on board - Helping guests get on and off the boat - Working with the skipper to ensure a smooth sailing - Keeping the boat neat and tidy - Providing our guests with the very best experience! We offer you: 
- The very best job on the water in the heart of Amsterdam - A competitive salary and good tips - Flexible working hours - Working in a young and fun team - The very best company parties! We ask of you: 
- You are sociable, energetic and 18 years or older - You dare to speak in front of a group - You are flexible and can work well independently - You are good at communicating and transferring information - You have a good command of the English language (additional languages are an advantage) - You are available at least 2 days a week, including 1 weekend day - You are willing to work evenings Apply? 
Send an email to info@kinboat.com and briefly tell us who you are and why you fit in with KINboat. We will contact you soon!

 This is what you need to know if you are a truck driver… or want to become one 
Of course: you spend a lot of time on the road and transport (often) goods from A to B. But behind that steering wheel lies a profession where responsibility, independence, and craftsmanship come together. Whether you are just starting or have been driving for years: this is what you need to know as a truck driver. You are the business card on wheels 
As a driver, you represent not only yourself, but also your employer and the client. You are present on customer sites, at loading and unloading locations, and sometimes even at private addresses. A professional attitude, clear communication, and keeping agreements are therefore just as important as good driving skills. Safety always comes first 
Safe working as a professional driver is not a side issue. You deal with heavy vehicles, changing weather conditions, and busy traffic. Knowing and respecting driving and rest time regulations is essential, as is correctly securing cargo. Even small things, such as getting in and out safely, staying alert when reversing, and paying attention to blind spots, make a big difference. If you want to refresh this knowledge, you can consider the training 'Updating professional competence for drivers'. This also falls under the Code 95 regulation. 
In addition, it is important not only to drive safely, but also to know how to act when something goes wrong. Training such as first aid (EHBO), emergency response (BHV), and VCA provides practical knowledge about working safely, recognizing risks, and acting correctly in case of incidents. Dealing with stress and emotions

Every day, together with your colleagues, you ensure that thousands of second-hand treasures and parcels are sorted quickly and accurately before being shipped to customers across the Netherlands, Belgium, and France. If you enjoy working in a dynamic environment and like staying active, this will be a great place to work for you. 
 Over de functie 
You can choose the shift that best fits your schedule and will be assigned to that shift on a weekly basis, providing stability and consistency. 
You will join a vibrant and international team where your colleagues are friendly and English-speaking. The warehouse offers a modern, well-equipped working environment with a strong focus on teamwork, efficiency, and operational excellence. 
This is a great opportunity to become part of a young, dynamic team where your contribution directly supports a smooth and successful logistics operation. 
Working hours: - Morning: 06:30 - 15:00 - Afternoon: 15:30 - 00:30 - Night: 00:00 - 06:30 
What You'll Do as a Warehouse Worker: - Unload incoming containers filled with parcels and start the sorting process. - Place parcels on automated sorting belts and platforms, ensuring they reach the correct destination. - Pack sorted parcels and load outgoing containers safely and efficiently for international transport. - Check shipping labels for accuracy and readability. - Maintain a clean, organized, and safe working environment together with your colleagues. - Contribute to a positive team atmosphere while helping the operation run smoothly.
